title: Revise per-job PR landing design note with a scorable measurement
summary: Retry of rejected job 20261109-055645-r796 (and earlier 20261109-014709-kxrd): write docs/design/per-job-pr-landing.md, removing the shared local landing branch, citing review 20261109-055516-tzwd. It fixes each verifier finding: treat the 1996.9-minute figure as mostly a measurement effect and score the 5.0-minute saving on a first-landing stage. It adds a CHANGELOG.md entry.

defaults_applied.how: Note written for an outside reader.
Every number carries a source or an estimate label.
Note lists alternatives and the existing code.
Criteria check the measurement method and premise table, not only section existence.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal and audience: a design note that the next throughput review and a maintainer can use to score the predicted 5.0 min/job saving against real data.

Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/land.rs, crates/athena-core/src/pr.rs, crates/athena-core/src/gh/landing.rs (land_pr, plan_rebase, rebase_job_branch), crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs (rebase_needs_recheck), docs/design/continuous-landing.md, docs/design/per-job-main-landing.md, docs/design/per-job-landing-branches.md, docs/design/squash-chain-landing.md, docs/design/native-pr-landing.md. The path crates/athena-core/src/drain.rs does not exist; the drain code is crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs.
Environment: none needed beyond reading the repository; the note describes pull request landing but nothing is pushed or run, and no records or history are read.

Prior job 20261109-055645-r796 is addressed by fixing every finding: (1) section 6 adopts per-job-main-landing.md section 5, scoring the verifier-end to FIRST-landing-record stage and not the headline fall, which comes from the newest record listing a commit; (2) sections 1 and 4 call the 1996.9 minutes mostly a measurement effect, with the real first-landing wait about 4.6 minutes (sample median, per per-job-main-landing.md section 1), consistent with 5.0; (3) CHANGELOG.md gets an Added entry; (4) the note says how it relates to and supersedes per-job-main-landing.md, including which review citation applies; (5) the Existing code table names the stack replay code above.

The earlier candidate's only changed file, docs/design/per-job-pr-landing.md, is dropped and rewritten from the base. Its edits to CHANGELOG.md and roadmap.md were reverted by the producer; CHANGELOG.md is now a deliverable, and roadmap.md is kept as an optional deliverable (a pointer, as precedent per-job-landing-branches.md).

Premise table: section 1 lists every headline number with its source (THROUGHPUT.md, a record query, or a cited note such as agent-and-build-slots.md) and whether that source calls it a measurement effect. Numbers not re-measured are labeled estimates.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/per-job-pr-landing.md exists and its section 1 has a table of every headline number (1996.9, 2063.6, 5.0, 4.6 minutes) with a source column and a column saying whether the source calls it a measurement effect; the 1996.9 figure is described as mostly a measurement effect, not a serial queue wait (Read the file).
The note cites throughput review 20261109-055516-tzwd and states the predicted saving of 5.0 minutes per landed job against the 2063.6 median (Grep for the id and '5.0').

Section 6 names the timestamps it uses and scores the saving on the verifier-end to first-landing-record stage, explicitly not the headline landing-and-rebuild fall, and says what a drop far larger than 5.0 means; it says how the next throughput review applies it (Grep 'first landing' and 'next throughput review').
Sections 1 and 4 agree with the 5.0-minute prediction: neither describes the 1996.9 minutes as time the design removes (Read the sections).

The note has an Existing code section that reuses or extends land.rs, pr.rs, gh/landing.rs (land_pr, plan_rebase, rebase_job_branch), crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs (rebase_needs_recheck) and the continuous-landing, per-job-main-landing, per-job-landing-branches and squash-chain-landing notes, saying what each contributes and tagging each recommendation new or already present.
The note says how it relates to per-job-main-landing.md and which review citation supersedes which, and lists alternatives with reasons for rejection.
CHANGELOG.md has a new Added entry for per-job-pr-landing.md (git diff CHANGELOG.md).
Only docs/design/per-job-pr-landing.md, CHANGELOG.md and optionally docs/design/roadmap.md change; no crates/, athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflow file changes (git diff --stat).
cargo test and cargo clippy pass with the doc change, including the policy tests for design docs (run cargo test).

out_of_scope: Implementing the change in crates/ code
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
Changes to existing design notes other than an optional roadmap pointer
